comment: Every name C++ drives in the sky's materials. Mirrors Source/DeepSpace/Sky/SkyMaterialContract.h; Tools/setup_sky_materials.py authors from it and DeepSpace.Sky.MaterialContract holds the header, this file and the built assets to the same lists. Keys under 'parameters' are roles the authoring script wires by; 'name' is the only place the Unreal name is written.

constants.surface_comment: M_SkyBody's face: noise on the unit direction in object space, so every frequency is in cycles per body radius. One coarse band (continents and basins, or the belts' wander) and three detail bands sixteen times apart, each of detail_levels octaves at level_scale; every octave fades out by the pixel footprint once its wavelength is under filter_pixels, so what shows is always what the screen can hold. surface_max_swing bounds the face at 1 +/- it times the smooth disc, whatever the CVars say: the half-float ceiling is never nearer than it was.
